appraisal_events.evidence: Toute la faveur de Charlus s'était portée dès le mariage de sa fille adoptive sur le jeune marquis de Cambremer... ne firent naturellement que le lui faire apprécier davantage quand il fut veuf.
appraisal_events.explanation: Charlus's favor and intimacy shift decisively onto the young marquis de Cambremer, who becomes a valued, favored companion in the baron's circle.

appraisal_events.evidence: J'avais appris que Gilberte était malheureuse, trompée par Saint-Loup, mais pas de la manière que tout le monde croyait, que peut-être elle-même croyait encore, qu'en tout cas elle disait.
appraisal_events.explanation: Gilberte is presented as an unhappy, deceived wife who is even mistaken about the true nature of her husband's betrayal, a pitiable and diminished position distinct from the accepted blame directed at Saint-Loup.

status_effects.explanation: He gains standing as Charlus's newly favored, appreciated companion after becoming a widower.
He is drawn into Charlus's valued intimate circle as a charming, welcome companion.
She is portrayed as unhappy and deceived, and even self-deceived about the true nature of her husband's infidelity.

ambiguities: The candidate 'la grand-mère' is triggered by the phrase 'du côté de sa grand'mère,' which refers to the marquis de Cambremer's own grandmother, not the narrator's grandmother defined in the alias map as 'ma grand-mère'; it was therefore treated as a different, non-canonical entity and not scored.

Jupien delivers an extended indignant speech and the narrator affirms his sincerity ('Jupien était sincère dans son indignation'), but this reads more as an essayistic generalization about 'personnes dites immorales' than a staged local status shift, so it was left unscored to avoid manufacturing a weak event.

Gilberte's diminishment (S2) is closely tied to the same underlying situation as the accepted blame of Saint-Loup (E1); it is offered as a distinct emotional/social outcome for Gilberte herself rather than a restatement or reversal of the accepted event.
